name: Resume parser
description: AI-powered resume and CV parsing for viaSocket workflows. Automatically extract structured candidate data, name, email, phone, skills, experience, and education, from PDF, DOCX, or image files, then validate, enrich, and route it to Google Sheets, Airtable, or your ATS. Trigger Slack approvals, run bulk parsing jobs, and store normalized records in viaSocket Tables. Ideal for HR teams and recruiters automating intake and screening.

events.d: Extract a candidate's name, contact info, skills, work experience, and education from a resume or CV (PDF, DOCX, or image).
